title: Semantic QA for every schema and node type
description: Runs the QA registry in src/tools/qa.py. Every schema the folio defines or reuses has checks beyond shape: references resolve, counts match, and files exist at their sha256. A schema with no check is the finding qa-missing, and a registry entry for a vanished schema is qa-orphan. Accepted upstream facts are listed in qa-known.json, which is itself checked. Exit 1 on any finding. validate.py runs it, and CI runs validate.py on every push and PR.
